owner_direction: Allow the Environment Designer or training environment to expose solution structure early so the 2B policy can acquire the capability, then tighten the environment as capability grows.

paper_basis.paper: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments
paper_basis.section_4_2: Privileged hints expose a strategy, partial solution, or key observation, while the ordinary hint writer is instructed not to reveal the exact answer.
paper_basis.appendix_c_1: Single-turn environments reveal the exact solution when the turn limit is reached so the model learns from failure.
paper_basis.appendix_g_1_2: The observed curriculum moves from an early, strongly guided environment toward state-gated interaction and finer reward grading later in training.
paper_basis.interpretation: Leakage is a curriculum mechanism at the environment and feedback level, not a reason to contaminate held-out evaluation or relabel an exact-answer replay as an ordinary nonleaking SPADE hint.

relationship_to_frozen_records.prospective_change: The prior no-oracle-in-context prohibition no longer applies to explicitly labeled, train-gen-only early curriculum scaffolds. It remains binding for held-out evaluation and ordinary hint-regret measurement.
